title: Juice N Power Strawberry Lemonade Berries 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Fresh, tangy and sweet, Strawberry Lemonade Berries is a delicious harmony of ripe red berries and refreshing citrus lemonade by Juice N Power is an irresistible all-day vape. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks.
